subject: Treatment interactions with group-level treatment and group-level variable

messages.author: 28b7830a49c6e276
messages.subject: Treatment interactions with group-level treatment and group-level variable
parts: Let's say I have panel data with company-year units. They are clustered into countries and sectors. I want to see if the effect of a treatment at the country level varies by sector. I'm struggling with how I might do this in Stan (using RStan). Does anyone know of an existing example?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Treatment interactions with group-level treatment and group-level variable
parts:
There are varying slope and varying intercept models in the ARM
examples:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Example-Stan-Models

Peter has it nicely organized so that there's a whole section just
of varying slope and intercept models:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/ARM-Models-Sorted-by-Type#varying-intercept-and-slope

- Bob
